values.note: A single roadside site, 009 Haunted Hollow (North loop), on Ridge Road just before Middle Ridge Road. Back-in, max vehicle length 45 ft, 31-ft gravel driveway at a slight grade, full sun.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=883550&siteId=29396 ('Max Vehicle Length: 45', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Driveway Length: 31', 'Shade: Full Sun', 'ROAD LOCATION: Ridge Road ... values.note: The two official pages disagree: the booking site lists this site 'Open year round', while DCNR's Michaux camping page says only four parking-lot sites (#1, #2, #21, #22) are available in the winter camping season, from the third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1, and 'All other campsites are closed'.

season.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=883550&siteId=29396 ('Status: Open year round') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/michaux/camping ('The winter camping season in Michaux State Forest annually begins the third Sunday following Thanksgiving and ends April 1', 'During the winter camping season, the following designated motorized campsites are available for reservation: Campsite #1 -- Big Flat Parking Lot Campsite #2 -- Piney Mountain Parking Lot Campsite #21 -- Teaberry Parking Lot Campsite #22 -- Peggy's Hill Parking Lot All other campsites are closed'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/michaux/camping ('A permit and reservation is always required for motorized, roadside camping', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=883550&siteId=29396 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm'), read 2026-10-20

note: Michaux State Forest motorized roadside site 009 Haunted Hollow, on Ridge Road just before Middle Ridge Road: one back-in site in full sun, listed for vehicles up to 45 ft on a short gravel driveway. No water body adjacent; no water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 717-352-2211. Not one of the four Michaux sites DCNR keeps open in the winter season (third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1), though the booking site lists it open year round. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site with a 45-ft max vehicle length, reservation always required (fcfs never); season recorded as a note because DCNR (winter closure) and ReserveAmerica ('Open year round') disagree. Note rewritten as clean prose. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
